t: Block coding that creates designs a machine can stitch.
steps: Open the TurtleStitch site in a browser.
Start coding with no account to try the tool.
Read the offline usage page for lab computers.
Request teacher status to create student logins.
Check that your embroidery machine accepts TurtleStitch export files.
Export a short design and load it on the machine.
Remind students that cloud saved projects are public by default.
